decision.reason: [ev-518a56c0e2c1] is only a one-line bug-fix title. It does not say whether the "scheduling flake" affected running clusters or only the test suite ("flake" often means a flaky test). It also does not name any configuration, resource or version range linked to the problem. If the fix only touched tests, no environment is exposed, and the proposed undecidable runtime-behavior exposure would wrongly suggest some environments may be. To decide, I need the PR #6491 description or diff, to show whether runtime scheduling code changed and under what conditions the flake happened.
